sources.full: Varrenmoor Session 2: The Night of the Nox
Varrenmoor Wyrdcrafts and Tier 2–3 Spells, Plutonium Clean v3

feat.name: Runecrafting

entries.name: Foundry Installation
entries: Import this rules entry through Plutonium's Feats importer, then run the Varrenmoor Foundry v14/DnD5e 5.3.1 installer macro on the character. The macro adds the shared Uses pool, Long Rest recovery, level-gated activities, and charge consumption.

Runecrafting is Stellan's ability to read and alter written magical structure. A complete inscription is a sentence made from a subject, one or more Root Runes, a scope, a trigger, and a physical or metaphysical anchor.

entries.name: Craft Check and Save DC
entries: When a Runecrafting technique calls for a check, roll {@dice 1d20} + your proficiency bonus + your chosen Runecrafting ability modifier. Choose Intelligence or Wisdom when you gain this feature.
Your Runecrafting save DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + that ability modifier.

entries.name: Root Rune Key

items: {@b Eirwyn:} Preserve, Mend, Reveal, Threshold.
{@b Ikkander:} Bind, Measure, Weight, Turn.
{@b Vaelweyr:} Root, Breath, Track, Bloom.
{@b Mwooreth:} Sever, Hunger, Silence, False Hearth.

entries: Knowing a rune's name does not mean you know its graphic form. A Root Rune becomes available only after Stellan discovers and studies its corresponding glyph.

entries.name: Read Inscription — 0 Charges
entries: As an action, or over 10 minutes for a careful reading, examine a rune, ward, curse-mark, ritual diagram, magical door, or other inscription. On a successful Runecrafting check, learn one property, plus one additional property for every 5 points by which you exceed its Wyrd DC: its Root Runes, subject, scope, trigger, anchor, purpose, stability, later alterations, safe activation method, or defined backlash.
If you have never discovered one of its Root Runes, you learn its tradition and broad function but not its exact glyph or grammar.

entries.name: Trace Rune — 1 Charge, Level 2
entries: As an action, touch or trace a known Root Rune already present in an inscription. Make a Runecrafting check against its Wyrd DC. On a success, choose one: activate it once, suppress it until the start of your next turn, reveal its target or trigger, redirect its next use to another valid target, or prevent its next activation.
At level 5, a successful suppression can last for 1 minute while you concentrate as though concentrating on a spell.

entries.name: Repair Line — 1 Charge, Level 3
entries: Over 1 minute, repair one damaged line using a material appropriate to the inscription's anchor. On a successful Runecrafting check, improve the inscription from Fraying to Strained or from Strained to Stable.
If you knowingly use an unsuitable material, make the check with disadvantage. On a failure, the inscription's stability worsens by one step and its defined backlash occurs.

entries.name: Countermark — 1 Charge, Level 4
entries: As an action or reaction when an inscription activates within 30 feet, place a known opposing Root Rune into its sentence. Make a Runecrafting check against its Wyrd DC. On a success, suppress one Root Rune for 1 minute.
Common oppositions include Reveal against Silence or False Hearth, Mend against Sever, Preserve against Hunger, Turn against Track, and Measure against a concealed or imbalanced component.
If you succeed by 5 or more, you may instead worsen the inscription's stability by one step.

entries.name: Compose Rune Sentence — 2 Charges, Level 4
entries: Over 10 minutes, combine two known Root Runes into a temporary inscription affecting one creature, handheld object, door, window, or 5-foot section of terrain. Define its subject, scope, trigger, and suitable anchor when it is written.

The inscription lasts until your next long rest or until it activates, unless its sentence states a shorter duration. The GM sets its Wyrd DC and adjudicates the result from the literal meanings of its Root Runes.
At level 6, you may compose a sentence containing three Root Runes and affect something as large as a wagon, room, gate, or 15-foot area.

entries.name: Prepared Rune Tile — 1 Charge, Level 5
entries: During a short or long rest, prepare one portable Tier I inscription on a tile, strip of cloth, nail, paper charm, or similar anchor. It reproduces one use of Trace Rune or a two-rune sentence you know.
The holder activates it using the activation listed on the tile. It is destroyed when activated. You can maintain one prepared tile at level 5 and two at level 7.

entries.name: Deep Inscription — 2 Charges, Level 7
entries: After at least 10 minutes of work, attempt to alter a Tier III inscription, create a large inscription, or place a temporary rune sentence on a willing living creature. Make a Runecrafting check against the effect's Wyrd DC.
A living inscription lasts no longer than 1 hour and cannot directly command the bearer, remove its free will, or permanently alter its body.

entries.name: Level 5 Short-Rest Recovery
entries: Once per long rest, after spending at least 10 minutes during a short rest studying, copying, or repairing a genuine rune, restore 1 spent Rune Charge. Increase this feature's remaining uses by 1, to its maximum.

entries.caption: Runecrafting Progression
rows: Read inscriptions; Trace known Tier I runes.
Repair inscriptions; attempt Tier II manipulation at the GM's Wyrd DC.
Prepare a rune tile; one short-rest recovery per long rest.
Compose three-rune sentences; permanently alter Tier II inscriptions through appropriate rituals.
Create large or living inscriptions; alter Tier III rune-work.

feat.name: Starweaving of Root and Spore

entries.name: Foundry Installation
entries: Import this rules entry through Plutonium's Feats importer, then run the Varrenmoor Foundry v14/DnD5e 5.3.1 installer macro on the character. The macro adds the shared Uses pool, Long Rest recovery, level-gated activities, and charge consumption.

Violet perceives plants and fungi as earthly constellations. This feature interacts only with botanical and fungal life: plants, fungi, spores, seeds, roots, mycelium, botanical creatures, fungal creatures, colonies, and connected living places.
It cannot read, heal, drain, bind, track, or alter humanoids, beasts, familiars, animal companions, animal tissue, or animal life force.

entries.name: Craft Check and Save DC
entries: When a Starweaving technique calls for a check, roll {@dice 1d20} + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier.
Your Starweaving save DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier.

entries.name: Green Patterns
entries: A botanical or fungal counterpart has a Kind, Vitality, Affinity, Network, and any Affliction affecting it.
{@b Vitality} is Thriving, Healthy, Strained, or Dying.
{@b Affinities} are natural qualities such as Climbing, Deep-Rooted, Thorned, Fruiting, Medicinal, Luminescent, Water-Storing, Cold-Hardy, Fast-Spreading, Adhesive, Decomposer, or Warning.
{@b Networks} include shared root systems, fungal colonies, grafted orchards, fields maintained as one cultivated system, and similar real biological connections.

{@b Afflictions} must be concrete conditions, such as root rot, plant disease, insect infestation, parasitic fungus, lack of water, damaged roots, forced magical growth, a rune preventing germination, or Mwooreth Hunger removing warmth from the soil.

entries.name: Read Green Pattern — 0 Threads
entries: As an action, or over 10 minutes for a careful reading, examine one plant, fungus, colony, botanical creature, fungal creature, or connected living place within 30 feet.

On a successful Starweaving check, learn one property, plus one additional property for every 5 points by which you exceed its Wyrd DC: Vitality, strongest Affinity, Network, direction or size of its Network, a concrete Affliction, an immediate physical need, magical alteration, removed or suppressed vitality, or a dormant seed, spore, graft, parasite, or foreign growth.
On a failed check, you still learn whether it is Thriving, Healthy, Strained, or Dying.

entries.name: Tie Green Thread — 1 Thread, Level 2
entries: As an action, connect two botanical or fungal counterparts within 30 feet for 10 minutes. Intelligent botanical or fungal creatures must be willing. Choose one bond:

items: {@b Root Relay.} While touching either target, know the direction and Vitality of the other within 1 mile.

{@b Shared Sustenance.} Move existing water and dissolved nutrients between the targets while they are within 60 feet. This can prevent one from becoming Strained, stabilize one Dying target, supply one plant for one day, or support one use of Quickening. It creates no water or nutrients.
{@b Sympathetic Growth.} The first Quickening used on either target also causes a reduced version of the same natural growth in the other.

entries: A counterpart can participate in only one Green Thread. At level 5, you can maintain two. At level 7, their duration becomes 1 hour.

entries.name: Quickening — 1 Thread, Level 2
entries: As an action, accelerate one natural process in existing viable plant or fungal tissue within 30 feet. You may germinate seeds, awaken spores, extend vines or mycelium through suitable material, cause roots to grip or release an object, open flowers or fruiting bodies, produce a small amount of ordinary fruit or mushrooms, brighten luminescent fungi, reveal the direction of root or fungal spread, or create difficult terrain in one 5-foot square of existing vegetation for 1 minute.

Alternatively, concentrate for 1 minute to accelerate approximately one week of ordinary growth. Affect one plant or 5-foot patch at levels 2–4, a 10-foot-radius patch at levels 5–6, or a 20-foot-radius patch at level 7.

Quickening creates no water, nutrients, light, viable tissue, or mature harvest from newly germinated seeds. If the accelerated growth uses more resources than the site can provide, it becomes Strained.

entries.name: Transfer Green Vitality — 1 Thread, Level 3
entries: As an action, touch a botanical or fungal source and recipient, or use two targets joined by a Green Thread. The source must be Healthy or Thriving and reduces its Vitality by one step. A botanical or fungal creature can instead expend one Hit Die or take {@dice 1d6} necrotic damage that cannot be reduced.

A non-creature recipient improves its Vitality by one step, to a maximum of Healthy unless the source was Thriving. A botanical or fungal creature recipient regains {@dice 1d8} + your Wisdom modifier hit points, increasing to {@dice 2d8} + your Wisdom modifier at level 5.
A handful of grass, loose leaves, a single weed, or similarly insignificant growth cannot serve as a source.

entries.name: Hold the Green Spark — 1 Thread, Level 4
entries: As a reaction when a botanical or fungal counterpart within 30 feet would die, be destroyed, or lose its last viable tissue, preserve one surviving spark.
A botanical or fungal creature reduced to 0 hit points becomes stable; if you touch it before the end of your next turn, it regains 1 hit point.

For a plant, fungus, colony, or living place, one viable root, seed, spore cluster, graft, mycelial patch, branch, or fruiting body survives for 1 hour. The cause of destruction must still be addressed.

entries.name: Share Green Affinity — 1 Thread, Level 5
entries: As an action, touch two botanical or fungal counterparts. For 1 hour, the recipient gains a limited expression of one Affinity naturally possessed by the source.

Examples include temporary climbing tendrils, resistance to uprooting, thorns dealing piercing damage equal to your proficiency bonus once per turn, natural luminescence, one additional harvest from a mature plant, ordinary frost tolerance, an adhesive bond requiring a Strength check against your Starweaving save DC, or a visible warning response when a creature enters within 10 feet.
A counterpart can receive only one shared Affinity at a time. A newly discovered Affinity receives one consistent mechanical expression when first used.

entries.name: Awaken Living Place — 2 Threads, Level 6
entries: Over 10 minutes, join a grove, field, orchard, garden, hedge, moss bed, fungal colony, or similar connected area within a 20-foot radius for 8 hours. Choose two effects: visible warning when creatures enter; reveal the direction of fire, cutting, digging, disease, or destructive magic; distribute available water and nutrients; ripen food already growing there; stabilize damaged plants or fungi; create difficult terrain for designated hostile creatures; resist ordinary fire, frost, drought, cutting, or uprooting; or retain a simple impression of major events.
The place does not become intelligent and cannot converse.

entries.name: Great Greenweave — 2 Threads, Level 7
entries: Over 1 minute, join up to six botanical or fungal counterparts within 60 feet for 1 hour. You know each member's direction and Vitality within 1 mile; water and nutrients can pass between members within 60 feet; Transfer Green Vitality can be used between any two members within 60 feet; one Quickening can affect two members; and members have advantage on checks or saves against fire, frost, disease, uprooting, forced magical growth, or unnatural decay.
Animals, humanoids, familiars, and animal-derived material cannot join the Greenweave.

entries.name: Level 5 Short-Rest Recovery
entries: Once per long rest, after spending at least 10 minutes during a short rest beneath the visible sky while maintaining contact with a living plant or fungus, restore 1 spent Star Thread. Increase this feature's remaining uses by 1, to its maximum.

entries.caption: Starweaving Progression
rows: Read Green Pattern, Tie Green Thread, Quickening.
Share Green Affinity, two simultaneous Green Threads, one short-rest recovery per long rest.
Great Greenweave; Green Threads last 1 hour.

feat.name: Essencecrafting

entries.name: Foundry Installation
entries: Import this rules entry through Plutonium's Feats importer, then run the Varrenmoor Foundry v14/DnD5e 5.3.1 installer macro on the character. The macro adds the shared Uses pool, Long Rest recovery, level-gated activities, and charge consumption.

Dale identifies useful magical properties inside physical substances, extracts those properties into prepared doses, and applies them to objects, tools, weapons, creatures, mechanisms, or existing environmental conditions.
The basic loop is Analyze Material, Extract Dose, then Apply Essence.

entries.name: Craft Check and Save DC
entries: When an Essencecrafting technique calls for a check, roll {@dice 1d20} + your proficiency bonus + your chosen Essencecrafting ability modifier. Choose Intelligence or Constitution when you gain this feature.
Your Essencecrafting save DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + that ability modifier.

entries.name: Essence-Bearing Materials
entries: Every relevant material has a Name, Essence, Potency, and Stability.
{@b Potency 1} is a common or weak property. {@b Potency 2} is an unusual or strong magical property. {@b Potency 3} is a unique Named Essence.

A Stable material can be extracted after successful analysis. Every Unstable material must state its exact backlash, such as fire damage from Ember, sudden fracture from Vaqmurrite, loss of warmth from Hunger, or temporary enforcement of a Gilt ownership mark.

items: {@b Iron:} reinforcement and cohesion.
{@b Stone:} weight, pressure, and endurance.
{@b Ember:} heat, ignition, and expansion.
{@b Rime:} cold, slowing, and preservation.
{@b Salt:} purification and boundaries.
{@b Ash:} concealment and traces left by exhausted magic.
{@b Bone:} physical shape and bodily memory.
{@b Root:} adhesion and natural growth.
{@b Gilt:} ownership, valuation, and magical exchange.
{@b Hunger:} consumption of heat, vitality, memory, or magical power.
{@b Vaqmurrite:} storage and release of stress through fractures.

entries.name: Analyze Material — 0 Charges
entries: As an action, or over 10 minutes for careful analysis, touch and examine a mineral, residue, bodily material, liquid, magical object, damaged structure, or environmental substance.

On a successful Essencecrafting check, learn its Essence, Potency, Stability, and one practical use. For every 5 points by which you exceed its Wyrd DC, also learn one of the following: what produced it, what can suppress it, whether someone deliberately altered it, one unusual use, whether extraction consumes the source, or its exact backlash.
On a failed check, you still learn whether it is mundane or Essence-bearing.

entries.name: Extract Dose — 0 or 1 Charge, Level 2
entries: Over 10 minutes, convert a viable sample into one consumable Essence Dose. Extraction costs no charge during a short or long rest, or 1 Essence Charge when performed at another time.
A Stable sample is extracted automatically after successful analysis. An Unstable sample requires a check against its Wyrd DC; on a failure, no dose is created and its stated backlash occurs.
A sample produces only the number of doses stated in its world entry. You can carry a number of prepared doses equal to your proficiency bonus.

entries.name: Apply Essence — 1 Charge and 1 Dose, Level 2
entries: As an action, consume one prepared dose and apply its fundamental property to a valid touched target. An application to an unwilling creature requires a melee Essencecrafting attack using proficiency bonus + your Essencecrafting ability modifier.

items: {@b Iron:} reinforce a nonmagical object for 10 minutes, or grant a willing creature +1 AC until the start of your next turn.
{@b Stone:} double an unattended object's effective weight for 10 minutes, or grant advantage against being shoved, pulled, or knocked prone for 1 minute.

{@b Ember:} ignite an unattended combustible object, heat up to 1 gallon of liquid, or cause the next hit with a treated weapon within 1 minute to deal an extra {@dice 1d6} fire damage ({@dice 1d8} at level 5).
{@b Rime:} preserve organic material for 24 hours, freeze up to 1 gallon of exposed liquid, or cause the next hit with a treated weapon to reduce speed by 10 feet until the target's next turn.

{@b Salt:} reveal poison, disease, curse magic, or unnatural decay in touched matter; grant advantage on one related saving throw within 1 minute; or suppress a Tier I ownership, possession, or curse effect on an object for 1 round.
{@b Ash:} conceal mundane tracks in a 10-foot square, conceal one visible mark or magical trace from casual observation for 1 hour, or grant {@dice 1d4} to one Stealth check within 10 minutes.

{@b Bone:} brace a damaged body part for safe movement, grant temporary hit points equal to your Essencecrafting ability modifier + proficiency bonus, or preserve the physical shape of a severed or damaged organic sample for 24 hours.
{@b Root:} adhere two unattended surfaces for 10 minutes, strengthen existing roots into one 5-foot square of difficult terrain, or keep an injured plant alive for 1 hour.
{@b Gilt:} reveal the recognized owner of a magical object, reveal the payment or sacrifice required by an Exchange mechanism, or suppress a Tier I ownership mark for 1 round.

{@b Hunger:} remove heat from an unattended object, draw up to 1 gallon of exposed liquid into the dose, or suppress a Tier I magical effect until your next turn. Then make a DC 13 Essencecrafting check; on failure, the effect also draws from the nearest valid source as specifically described by the GM before use.

{@b Vaqmurrite:} mark one visible crack, damaged object, construct, or rigidly armored creature. The next successful attack against it within 1 minute deals an extra {@dice 2d6} damage of the attack's type.

entries.name: Neutralize Essence — 1 Charge, Level 3
entries: As an action or reaction within 10 feet of a visible release, suppress one active Essence effect until the start of your next turn. A Tier II or Tier III effect requires a successful Essencecrafting check against its Wyrd DC.
At level 5, a successful suppression can last for 1 minute while you concentrate as though concentrating on a spell.

entries.name: Catalyze Existing Property — 1 Charge and 1 Dose, Level 4
entries: As an action, consume an appropriate dose to accelerate a physical property already present within 30 feet. You cannot create a reaction without the necessary material.

Examples include igniting visible oil or coal dust with Ember, collapsing an already cracked wall with Stone, freezing water already inside a lock with Rime, driving existing roots through visible cracks with Root, crystallizing a known poison or curse residue with Salt, revealing a magical ownership mark with Gilt, releasing stress stored in a visible fracture with Vaqmurrite, or drawing heat from an existing flame with Hunger.

entries.name: Field Distillation — Level 5
entries: Once per long rest during a short rest, process a viable sample and choose one: restore 1 spent Essence Charge, or create one Potency 1 Essence Dose without spending a charge. If restoring a charge, increase this feature's remaining uses by 1, to its maximum.

entries.name: Combine Two Essences — 2 Charges and 2 Doses, Level 6
entries: Over 10 minutes, combine two compatible doses into one combined dose that performs one valid effect from each Essence when applied to the same target. You can maintain only one combined dose at a time.

If either dose is Unstable, make an Essencecrafting check against the higher Wyrd DC. On a failure, the combined dose immediately activates against its container or nearest valid target, using the exact backlashes listed by its component materials.

entries.name: Refine Named Essence — 2 Charges, Level 7
entries: Over 1 hour, distill a Potency 3 campaign material into one unique consumable Named Essence. Its effect is established from its specific source when discovered and remains consistent.
You can possess only one Named Essence at a time.

entries.name: Essence Formulas
entries: The spells Distill the Blow, Vaqmurrite Faultline, and Ikkander's Crucible are also included as activities on this feature. Activating them through Essencecrafting consumes this feature's charges and the listed physical dose, functions while you are raging, and is not considered casting a spell.

entries.caption: Essencecrafting Progression
rows: Analyze, extract, and apply Potency 1 Essences.
Field Distillation; one short-rest recovery or free Potency 1 dose per long rest.

item.name: Marble-and-Brass Chest
entries: A carved chest of white marble veined with pale blue and bound in greened brass. Four circular keyholes surround a central knot of water, flame-shadow, iron, and root.
The chest does not open upward. When all four keys are turned together, it unfolds.

item.name: Eirwyn Key
entries: A pale brass key, cold to the touch, shaped with flowing water and light motifs.

item.name: Mwooreth Key
entries: A darkened brass or black iron key, warm in the hand and hooked like a thorn.

item.name: Ikkander Key
entries: A heavy, squared key with gear-like teeth. It feels like a tool as much as a key.

item.name: Vaelweyr Key
entries: A greened brass key wrapped in old root fibers, almost organic in shape.

item.name: Maerwyn's Diary
entries: The diary of Maerwyn of the First Door, an ancient Eirwyn priest. It contains fragments on the four religions, the Nox, and the old winter stores along the eastern ridgeline.
If the dead knock, do not answer with grief. Answer with names. A thing of the Nox may steal a voice, but it cannot bear a true name spoken with love.

item.name: Unknown Warm Egg
entries: A large pale gray egg, warm with living heat. Beneath the shell, faint veins of opal, brass, and green shimmer in candlelight.
Bones warns: Do not let the shadow things hear it crack.

item.name: Bones' Gravekeeper Shovel
entries: A rusted shovel with a silver-gray wooden handle wrapped in old linen. Burned into the handle are the words: For the sleeping. Not the stealing.

monster.name: Lesser Nox
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but speaks only in stolen voices

trait.name: Mimic Voice
entries: The Nox can imitate any voice it has heard since the previous dusk. A creature that succeeds on a DC 12 Wisdom (Insight) check notices a wrong cadence, missing breath, or false answer.

trait.name: Threshold Weakness
entries: While inside a warded building through an invitation or broken threshold, the Nox takes 2 radiant damage at the start of its turn if a hearth rite is active.

action.name: Cold Hand
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage.

monster.name: Hollow Nox
languages: understands Common and one local language but speaks only in stolen voices

trait.name: Borrowed Voice
entries: As a bonus action, the Hollow Nox imitates a voice known to a creature within 60 feet. That creature must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take reactions until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Door-Scratcher
entries: If the Hollow Nox spends its action clawing a ward, door rune, or threshold mark, the protection weakens until a creature repairs or reasserts the rite with an action and a successful DC 12 Religion check.

trait.name: True Name Weakness
entries: If a creature speaks the true name of the person whose voice the Hollow Nox is wearing, the Hollow Nox has disadvantage on its next attack roll or saving throw before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Grasping Shadow
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) necrotic damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the Nox's next turn.

spell.name: Bellglow

m.text: a tiny bell, chime, or sliver of polished metal threaded with white cord

entries: You ring, tap, or whisper into a small charm, causing pale bell-light to gather around one creature you can see within range.
The target gains one of the following benefits of your choice until the start of your next turn:

items: It gains a +1 bonus to AC against the next attack made against it.
It gains a +1d4 bonus to the next Wisdom saving throw it makes.
It sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius and cannot be hidden from you.

entries: The protective AC bonus increases to +2 when you reach 5th level.

entries.name: Tradition
entries: Eirwyn. This is young preservation magic: enough to make fate hesitate.

spell.name: White Thread Stitch

m.text: white thread dipped in clean water

entries: You press wet white thread to a wound and pull the body's pattern back together. The target regains hit points equal to {@dice 1d6} + your spellcasting ability modifier.

Until the start of your next turn, if the target would be reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, the target drops to 1 hit point instead and this protection ends. A creature can benefit from this protection only once per long rest.

entries.name: Tradition
entries: Eirwyn. Stellan is literally stitching someone's Wyrd back into place.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Gravewater Ward

time.condition: which you take when a creature within range takes necrotic damage, fire damage, or damage from a cursed or magical source

m.text: a drop of clean water touched to ash, bone, or burial linen

entries: You call on an old funerary protection to keep the living from being claimed too early. Reduce the triggering damage by {@dice 1d10} + your spellcasting ability modifier.
If the damage is reduced to 0, the protected creature also gains temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

entries.name: Tradition
entries: Eirwyn. The rite says, 'Not yet.'

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage reduction increases by {@dice 1d10} for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Fray the Name

m.text: a black thread rubbed with soot

entries: You speak a creature's name, title, or description and tug at the thread of its Wyrd. One creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw.

On a failed save, until the end of your next turn, the target subtracts {@dice 1d4} from the next attack roll or saving throw it makes, and it cannot take reactions. On a successful save, it suffers only one of those effects, chosen by you.

entries.name: Tradition
entries: Mwooreth. It weakens the target's place in the pattern before it harms the body.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Hakon's Quieting Cord

m.text: a strip of burial linen or bell-cord knotted around black thread

entries: You bind a creature's voice to the silence of the grave. One creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw.

On a failed save, the target cannot speak, cannot provide verbal components for spells, and cannot use abilities that require a spoken command. At the end of each of its turns, the target may repeat the saving throw, ending the spell on a success.
If the target takes radiant damage while affected by this spell, it has disadvantage on its next saving throw against this spell.

entries.name: Tradition
entries: Eirwyn and Mwooreth. It can be a protective silence or a sinister silencing.

spell.name: Winter Bell Benediction

m.text: snowmelt or clean water poured over bell metal; the water is consumed

entries: You perform a small village rite of preservation, binding warmth, breath, and memory into the targets. Choose up to six creatures within range. Each target gains 5 temporary hit points.

For the duration, each target may add {@dice 1d4} to one saving throw it makes against being frightened, charmed, poisoned, or cursed. Once a creature uses this bonus, it cannot use it again from this casting.

entries.name: Tradition
entries: Eirwyn. This is a pre-winter, pre-battle, funeral, or protect-the-village blessing.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the temporary hit points increase by 5 for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Silver Needles of Judgment

m.text: three short lengths of silver or white thread

entries: You cast silver-white threads of light that pierce a creature's pattern. Make a ranged spell attack against one creature within range. On a hit, the target takes {@dice 3d8} radiant damage.
If the target is concentrating on a spell, curse, ritual, or magical effect, it has disadvantage on the saving throw it makes to maintain concentration.
Until the end of your next turn, the next attack roll made against the target scores a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

entries.name: Tradition
entries: Eirwyn. This weaponizes weaving against things that should not be holding together.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Fennfield Snare

m.text: a root, grain stalk, or length of farm twine pressed into soil

entries: Choose a 10-foot square of ground you can see within range. Roots, weeds, straw, mud, and field-grass twist into a living snare.

The area becomes difficult terrain. When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it is restrained until the start of its next turn.
A restrained creature can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC, freeing itself on a success.

entries.name: Tradition
entries: Vaelweyr. The farm itself grabs intruders.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the affected area increases to a 15-foot square.

spell.name: Winterberry Compact

m.text: seven seeds, a drop of clean water, and a pinch of soil; the seeds are consumed

entries: You awaken a handful of hardy berries, rootlets, or seed pods with Vaelweyr's old promise: life survives winter.

You create a number of winterberries equal to your proficiency bonus + your spellcasting ability modifier. A creature can use an action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 hit point and provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day.

A creature that eats one also gains advantage on its next saving throw against exhaustion caused by cold, hunger, or forced travel within the next 24 hours. The berries lose their magic after 24 hours.

entries.name: Tradition
entries: Vaelweyr and Eirwyn. In a winter food-crisis story, this knowledge is social and political power.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you create two additional berries for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Moon-Thread Briar

m.text: a thorn wrapped in white thread and touched with moonlit water

entries: You cause pale briars of moonlit root and thorn to erupt in a 5-foot-radius area centered on a point you can see within range.

Creatures in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@dice 2d6} radiant damage and is restrained until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half damage and is not restrained.
A creature that starts its turn in the briars must repeat the saving throw. As a bonus action on your turn, you may move the briar patch up to 10 feet along the ground.

entries.name: Tradition
entries: Vaelweyr and Eirwyn. Beautiful, cold, living, and dangerous.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Stable Sense

m.text: a grooming brush, bit of tack, feed, or shed animal hair

entries: You read the body language, breath, posture, and spirit of one beast or bonded companion within range. You learn one of the following:

items: Whether it is frightened, injured, poisoned, diseased, charmed, or magically influenced.
Its strongest immediate emotion.
Whether it considers a visible creature hostile, trusted, or unfamiliar.
Whether it is hungry, exhausted, or in pain.

entries: Before the end of your next turn, you gain a {@dice 1d4} bonus to one Wisdom (Animal Handling) check involving that creature.

entries.name: Tradition
entries: Vaelweyr. Betsy is magically good at what she was already good at.

spell.name: Trusting Rein

m.text: a strip of leather, rein, collar, or braided cord

entries: Choose one willing creature you can see within range. The target immediately gains temporary hit points equal to {@dice 1d6} + your spellcasting ability modifier.

Until the end of its next turn, the target may move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks from one creature of your choice. If the target is a beast, mount, familiar, or bonded companion, it may instead move up to its full speed.

entries.name: Tradition
entries: Vaelweyr. This is not domination. It is trust: Go. I've got you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the temporary hit points increase by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Herdline Ward

time.condition: which you take when a creature within range takes damage

m.text: a braided loop of stable twine or tack-leather

entries: You bind nearby allies into a momentary herd-line, spreading panic and pain before it breaks one creature.
Reduce the triggering damage by {@dice 1d8} + your spellcasting ability modifier. If another friendly creature is within 5 feet of the target, the reduction increases by your proficiency bonus.
If the protected target is a beast, mount, familiar, or bonded companion, it may also move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Tradition
entries: Vaelweyr and Eirwyn. Betsy protects people the way a herd protects its own.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage reduction increases by {@dice 1d8} for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Ironshoe Charge

m.text: a horseshoe nail, boot nail, or small iron ring

entries: Choose one willing creature within range. Until the spell ends, the target's speed increases by 10 feet.

The first time before the spell ends that the target moves at least 15 feet straight toward a creature and hits it with a melee attack, the attack deals an extra {@dice 1d6} bludgeoning damage, and the target of the attack must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet.
If the enchanted creature is mounted or is a beast or companion, the extra damage becomes {@dice 1d8}. The spell then ends.

entries.name: Tradition
entries: Ikkander and Vaelweyr. Stablecraft plus animal momentum.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by {@dice 1d6}, or {@dice 1d8} if mounted/beast/companion, for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Companion's Second Breath

m.text: warm cloth, feed, or a charm made from shed mane or fur

entries: Choose one creature you can see within range. The target regains hit points equal to {@dice 2d6} + your spellcasting ability modifier.

If the target is prone, it may immediately stand without spending movement. If the target is a beast, mount, familiar, or bonded companion, it may also move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Tradition
entries: Vaelweyr and Eirwyn. Betsy calls something back to its feet through bond and command.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the healing increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Shared Saddle Oath

m.text: two linked rings, bridle loops, or tied cords

entries: Choose two willing creatures within range. For the duration, the creatures know the direction and distance to one another as long as they are on the same plane of existence.

Once per round, when one bonded creature takes damage while within 60 feet of the other, the other bonded creature may use its reaction to take some of that harm. The reacting creature may reduce the damage by an amount up to your spellcasting ability modifier + your proficiency bonus. The reacting creature then takes damage equal to the amount reduced; this transferred damage cannot be reduced further.
If one of the bonded creatures is your companion, mount, or bonded beast, the maximum amount reduced increases by {@dice 1d6}.

entries.name: Tradition
entries: Vaelweyr. Shared danger is the purest form of tamer magic.

spell.name: Call of the Familiar Stable

m.text: a horseshoe, collar-ring, carved animal charm, or trusted tack-piece; consumed unless tied to a named companion

entries: You call a loyal beast-spirit shaped by your memory of stable, field, road, and home. Choose one form: pony, mule, riding horse, mastiff, goat, foxhound, or wolf if the story allows it.
The creature is a spirit with the chosen creature's statistics, but it is fey, primal, or spirit-touched rather than a normal beast. It understands your verbal commands.
In combat, the spirit acts on your initiative. It can move and take the Dodge action on its own. You can use a bonus action to command it to take another action from its stat block.
If reduced to 0 hit points, it vanishes, leaving behind the material component cracked or dulled.

entries.name: Tradition
entries: Vaelweyr and Ikkander. This is the stable answering Betsy.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the duration becomes 24 hours.

spell.name: First Hearth Rite

components.m: ash from a true hearth, clean water or snowmelt, a nail or iron filing from the protected door, a living sprig of evergreen, and the spoken name of someone the household refuses to forget

entries: You mark a doorway, window, or other threshold with an older rite of preservation and naming. Until the spell ends, creatures of the Nox and similar voice-stealing shadow spirits cannot enter through the protected threshold unless a creature inside knowingly invites them by name.

A creature attempting to mimic a voice across the threshold must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or its disguise falters: its shadow bends the wrong way, its breath vanishes, or its answer fails a local custom.
The rite does not bar ordinary villagers, beasts, or invited guests. It strengthens the truth of a threshold rather than creating a wall.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When cast using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you may protect one additional connected threshold for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Counterseal of the Open Eye

time.condition: which you take when a creature within 60 feet rolls a saving throw against a spell, rune, curse, or other magical effect, after the d20 is rolled but before the result is announced

m.text: a sliver of bell metal laid across a chalk drawing of an open eye

entries: You draw a brief Reveal rune across the effect's sentence. The triggering creature adds {@dice 1d6} to its saving throw.

If this bonus changes the saving throw from a failure to a success, you also learn the direction of the effect's caster, inscribed source, or physical anchor if it is within 300 feet of you. You learn only the direction, not its identity or distance.

entries.name: Wyrdcraft Interaction
entries: If the effect is a rune inscription whose Tier is no higher than you can normally alter with Runecrafting, you may immediately identify one Root Rune present in it without making a separate check.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When cast using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the bonus becomes {@dice 1d8}.

spell.name: Hearth-Seam Refuge

m.text: an iron door nail, a crust of bread, and ash from a family hearth

entries: You draw a seam around a door-sized portion of a solid vertical surface. The seam opens into a cramped extradimensional room modeled on Nior's impoverished childhood hearth: smoky, threadbare, warm, and barely large enough for eight Medium creatures to squeeze inside.

The room contains dim light and enough poor warmth to protect its occupants from ordinary cold. Creatures inside can complete a short rest, but the room is too cramped and uncomfortable to complete a long rest.

The entrance can be opened or closed from either side. While closed, it appears as a faint repaired crack; a creature examining it finds the entrance with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. Attacks and spells cannot pass through the closed entrance.
If the supporting surface is destroyed, or when the spell ends, every occupant is harmlessly expelled into the nearest unoccupied spaces. You can have only one Hearth-Seam Refuge active at a time.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When cast using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the duration increases by 1 hour for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Sentence of the Holding Door

m.text: an iron nail wrapped in white thread

entries: Choose a doorway, gate, bridge entrance, or line no longer than 15 feet between two solid anchors that you can see within range. A luminous sentence of Threshold, Bind, and Weight appears along it.

Choose any number of creatures you can see when you cast the spell. Those creatures can cross the sentence freely and have half cover while they are within 5 feet of it and the sentence lies between them and an attacker.

Any other creature that attempts to cross the sentence for the first time on a turn must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@dice 2d6} force damage, its speed becomes 0 until the start of its next turn, and it remains on the side from which it approached. On a successful save, it takes half damage and can cross normally until the end of that turn.
The sentence does not block projectiles, unattended objects, teleportation, or effects that do not physically cross its line.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When cast using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Mycelial Hearth

m.text: a living fungal sample, damp soil, and a shaving of dead wood

entries: Touch soil, dead wood, or another surface capable of supporting fungi. A sheltered 10-foot-radius bed of soft mycelium, shelf fungi, moss, and arching fruiting bodies grows around the point. The growth creates no solid wall, but it blocks wind, sheds ordinary rain, provides dim light, and keeps the area comfortably warm or cool for resting creatures.

Up to six creatures that complete a short rest entirely within the hearth gain temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier + your proficiency bonus. Each also gains advantage on the next saving throw it makes against poison or disease before its next long rest.
A creature can receive these benefits from Mycelial Hearth only once per long rest. The growth withers harmlessly when the spell ends.

spell.name: Starbloom Tether

m.text: a living vine tip and a pinch of luminescent spores

entries: Choose two unoccupied points on solid surfaces within range that are no more than 20 feet apart. A luminous vine and mycelial cord grows between them. The tether is 5 feet wide and can lie along the ground, climb a wall, or span a gap.

A creature that enters the tether's space for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it is {@condition restrained} until the end of its next turn. A restrained creature can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC, ending the condition on itself on a success.
The tether is an object with AC 13 and 15 hit points. It is immune to poison and psychic damage. If destroyed, the spell ends. Willing creatures can climb the tether as though it were a rope.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When cast using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the tether gains 5 hit points for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Crown of the Fruiting Star

m.text: a viable seed, a mushroom cap, and a drop of moonlit water

entries: Choose a point on soil, wood, or a surface containing living plant or fungal matter. Star-marked vines, roots, mushrooms, and mycelial fans surge through a 20-foot-radius area centered there.
Choose any number of creatures you can see when you cast the spell. Those creatures ignore the area's difficult terrain and have half cover while wholly within it.

For every other creature, the area is difficult terrain. When such a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@dice 2d6} piercing or radiant damage, chosen when you cast the spell, and is {@condition restrained} until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half damage and is not restrained.
A creature can take this damage only once per round. The conjured growth collapses into ordinary mulch and pale spores when the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When cast using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Distill the Blow

time.condition: which you take when you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, poison, thunder, bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage

m.text: a prepared Essence Dose matching the triggering damage; consumed when activated through Essencecrafting

entries: Reduce the triggering damage by {@dice 2d8} + your spellcasting ability modifier.

You retain a trace of the prevented force until the end of your next turn. The first time you hit with a melee weapon attack before then, the attack deals an additional {@dice 1d8} damage of the triggering type.

entries.name: Essence Formula
entries: Dale can activate this spell through his Essencecrafting feature instead of casting it. When he does so, he spends the listed Essence Charges from that feature and consumes the listed prepared dose. This activation is a craft technique, requires no spell slot, functions while he is raging, and is not considered casting or concentrating on a spell.
When activated through Essencecrafting, this formula costs 1 Essence Charge and one matching prepared Essence Dose.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When cast using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage reduction increases by {@dice 1d8} for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Vaqmurrite Faultline

m.text: a prepared Vaqmurrite Essence Dose; consumed when activated through Essencecrafting

entries: Choose one visible crack, damaged object, construct, or creature wearing rigid armor within range. An unwilling creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become marked by a glowing fracture line. An object or willing target is marked automatically.

The next time the marked target is hit by an attack before the spell ends, the attack deals an additional {@dice 3d6} force damage. If the target is a creature, it must then succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. The spell then ends.
Against an unattended nonmagical object or structure, the additional damage is maximized.

entries.name: Essence Formula
entries: Dale can activate this spell through his Essencecrafting feature instead of casting it. When he does so, he spends the listed Essence Charges from that feature and consumes the listed prepared dose. This activation is a craft technique, requires no spell slot, functions while he is raging, and is not considered casting or concentrating on a spell.
When activated through Essencecrafting, this formula costs 1 Essence Charge and one prepared Vaqmurrite Dose.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When cast using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the additional damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Ikkander's Crucible

m.text: a prepared Iron, Stone, Ember, or Rime Essence Dose; consumed when activated through Essencecrafting

entries: Choose Iron, Stone, Ember, or Rime when you activate the spell. The corresponding property suffuses your body and equipment for the duration:

items: {@b Iron.} You gain a +1 bonus to AC.
{@b Stone.} You have advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and you count as one size larger when determining carrying capacity and what you can push, drag, lift, grapple, or shove.
{@b Ember.} Once on each of your turns when you hit with a melee attack, the attack deals an extra {@dice 1d6} fire damage.
{@b Rime.} You have resistance to cold damage. The first creature you hit on each of your turns has its speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Essence Formula
entries: Dale can activate this spell through his Essencecrafting feature instead of casting it. When he does so, he spends the listed Essence Charges from that feature and consumes the listed prepared dose. This activation is a craft technique, requires no spell slot, functions while he is raging, and is not considered casting or concentrating on a spell.
When activated through Essencecrafting, this formula costs 2 Essence Charges and one prepared dose matching the chosen property.

spell.name: Herdstep Command

m.text: a loop of tack leather or braided stable cord

entries: Choose up to three willing creatures you can see within range. Each target may immediately use its reaction to move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
A beast, mount, familiar, or bonded companion targeted by the spell may instead move up to its full speed and can stand from prone without spending movement before it moves.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When cast using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Stableheart Ward

m.text: three knots tied in a strip of rein leather

entries: Choose up to three willing creatures within range. For the duration, each target has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
While a warded target is within 10 feet of another warded target, it also has advantage on checks and saving throws against being shoved, pulled, knocked prone, or moved against its will.
A beast, mount, familiar, or bonded companion affected by the spell also gains temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier + your proficiency bonus when the spell is cast.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When cast using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Oath of Fang and Rein

m.text: two linked collar rings, bridle rings, or leather loops

entries: Choose yourself and one willing beast, mount, familiar, or bonded companion within range. For the duration, each of you knows the direction and distance to the other while on the same plane, and both have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

Once per round when either bonded creature is hit by an attack while the other is within 60 feet, the other can use its reaction to move up to half its speed toward the attacker without provoking opportunity attacks.
If that movement ends within 5 feet of the damaged creature or the attacker, reduce the triggering damage by {@dice 1d8} + your spellcasting ability modifier.
The spell ends early if either bonded creature is incapacitated for more than 1 minute or willingly ends the oath.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When cast using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage reduction increases by {@dice 1d8} for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Rite of the Remaining Bone

m.text: the surviving bone fragment, a copper coin, grave soil, and clean water; the coin is consumed

entries: The holder of the surviving bone fragment can perform this ritual once per long rest without expending a spell slot, even if the holder is not otherwise a spellcaster. The holder chooses Wisdom or Charisma as the ritual's ability the first time it is completed.

The ritual can target the bone, another fragment of the same remains, an object made from or containing related remains, a creature or object bearing an ownership mark tied to bone, or a place where the remains were divided, sold, altered, or bound.
Choose one effect:

entries.name: Witness
entries: Ask one question about something the bone personally experienced. The answer arrives as a truthful sensory memory, emotion, word, gesture, or image. The bone knows only what it experienced.

entries.name: Seek the Rest
entries: For 1 hour, the bone pulls toward the nearest related fragment, matching remains, or place strongly connected to its division. You know the general direction but not the exact distance.

entries.name: Expose the Claim
entries: For 10 minutes, one ownership, command, market, silence, or identity-binding effect affecting the target becomes visible. You learn its magical tradition, Wyrd Tier, anchor, and the general nature of its release condition.
Beginning at character level 5, you can also suppress a Tier I ownership effect for 1 hour.
Beginning at character level 7, you can attempt to break a Tier II ownership effect by making a Wisdom or Charisma check against its Wyrd DC. On a failure, it is suppressed for 1 minute instead.
This ritual uses its own once-per-long-rest use. It never consumes Rune Charges, Star Threads, Essence Charges, or spell slots.

table.name: Varrenmoor Knock Customs
rows: Two slow knocks followed by two fast knocks
Bell-Knock: death, oath, birth, or church business
